ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in quadrilateral ABCD, connect AC and BD. If $\triangle ABC$ is an equilateral triangle, with $AB=BD$ and $\angle ABD=20^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle BDC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given an equilateral $\triangle ABC$ where $AB=BC$, $\angle ABC=60^\circ$, \\
since $AB=BD$, $\angle ABD=20^\circ$, \\
it follows that $BD=BC$, $\angle CBD=60^\circ-20^\circ=40^\circ$, \\
thus, $\angle BDC=(180^\circ-40^\circ)\div 2=\boxed{70^\circ}$.
